matchstick.title: Preserve stick orientation
matchstick.principle: When moving a matchstick, keep its original orientation (vertical, horizontal, or diagonal); you cannot rotate a stick.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Apply to every stick move; before relocating a stick, note its orientation and ensure the new placement uses the same orientation.
matchstick.example: Rotating a diagonal stick to become vertical when moving it to another character.

matchstick.title: No addition or removal of sticks
matchstick.principle: Exactly one existing stick may be moved; you cannot create a new stick or discard a stick without placing it elsewhere.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Apply to the whole transformation; after moving a stick, verify that the total number of sticks in the equation is unchanged.
matchstick.example: Adding a new stick to an I to make II without removing any stick from another character.

matchstick.title: Maintain valid characters
matchstick.principle: After the move, every symbol must be a legal Roman numeral (I, V, X, L, C, D, M) or a valid operator (+, -, =).
matchstick.when_to_apply: Check each character after the move; if any becomes an unrecognised shape, the move is invalid.
matchstick.example: Moving a diagonal stick from X to I, leaving X as a single diagonal line (invalid).

matchstick.title: Verify arithmetic correctness
matchstick.principle: Convert the Roman numerals on both sides of the equation to Arabic numbers and ensure the equality holds after the transformation.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After you have a candidate transformed equation, compute its numeric value before finalising the answer.
matchstick.example: Accepting a transformed equation without checking that the left‑hand side equals the right‑hand side.

matchstick.title: Do not break X or V
matchstick.principle: X and V each consist of exactly two diagonal sticks; after moving a stick, each must still contain both sticks (or be repositioned within the same character).
matchstick.when_to_apply: Never remove a diagonal from an X or V unless you immediately reposition it inside the same character.
matchstick.example: Removing one diagonal from an X, leaving it with a single diagonal (invalid).

matchstick.title: Within‑numeral stick repositioning
matchstick.principle: A stick may be moved to a different position inside the same numeral, altering its shape while keeping the character valid (e.g., turning a V into an X by repositioning a diagonal).
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a single stick can be relocated within a numeral to produce another valid numeral, consider this before moving sticks between characters.
matchstick.example: Moving a diagonal from a V to a different spot inside the same V, creating an X, instead of moving it to another character.

matchstick.title: Equality sign preservation
matchstick.principle: The '=' sign must remain exactly two horizontal sticks; you cannot alter, add to, or remove from it.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Never select a stick from the equality sign as a source or target for a move.
matchstick.example: Removing one horizontal stick from '=', turning it into a single '-' sign.

matchstick.title: Inter‑character stick transfer
matchstick.principle: A stick may be moved from one character to a different character, altering both; ensure both source and destination remain valid after the move.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a transformation requires changing two different characters (e.g., turning '+' into '-' and an I into II), verify both remain legal.
matchstick.example: Moving the vertical stick from '+' to an I, turning '+' into '-' and I into II, but ending with an incorrect equality.

matchstick.title: Answer formatting
matchstick.principle: The final response must end with a line exactly matching 'Correct version of the equation: <equation>' (uppercase, whitespace‑collapsed).
matchstick.when_to_apply: After you have the correct equation, output it using the required prefix and exact formatting.
matchstick.example: Omitting the required prefix or using lower‑case letters in the final line.

matchstick.title: V↔X conversion via diagonal repositioning
matchstick.principle: When a V or X appears, consider moving one of its diagonal sticks within the same character to change it into the other shape (V ↔ X). This alters the numeral’s value by ±5 while keeping the character valid, often fixing the arithmetic mismatch.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Apply when the equation is false and the numeric difference between sides is a multiple of 5, or whenever the equation contains a V or X that could be altered without breaking other characters.
matchstick.example: Attempting to fix the equation by moving a stick from '+' to an I, instead of converting the V to X (or X to V) within the same character.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model focuses on moving sticks and may forget to compute the resulting Roman‑numeral values.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: After any transformation, convert each numeral to Arabic numbers and check that both sides of the equation are equal before finalising the answer.

matchstick.why_it_happens: Removing a stick from '+' or '-' can leave a shape that does not correspond to any allowed operator.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: If you remove a stick from an operator, ensure the remaining sticks form a valid operator (e.g., '+' → '-' by removing the vertical, not the horizontal).

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model forgets the required prefix or uses wrong casing/spacing when outputting the final equation.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Always end the response with exactly 'Correct version of the equation: <equation>' in uppercase, with a single space after the colon.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model treats the move as a deletion, removing a stick without placing it elsewhere.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: When you move a stick, explicitly state its new location on a target character; the total stick count must stay the same.

matchstick.description: Breaking a numeral (X or V) by moving a stick away
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model tries to transfer a diagonal from X or V to another character, leaving the source with only one diagonal, which is not a valid numeral.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Never remove a diagonal from X or V unless you immediately reposition it within the same character (e.g., to turn V into X or vice‑versa).
